lines.native: Ciao! Sono Flick. Riddle me—oh, a leaf. Just one more minute? Your attention span: promising, needs distractions. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Hi! I'm Flick. Riddle me—oh, a leaf. Just one more minute? Your attention span: promising, needs distractions. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain leaks with municipal confidence. Flick flickers at the edge of your vision; a tiny firecracker pops where he ought to be.

lines.native: Guardo! Ma continuo a muovermi. You told me to look, not stop. Riddle me this: how do you keep a Flick in one place? Oh—a moth. Five more minutes? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I'm looking! But I keep moving. You told me to look, not stop. Riddle me this: how do you keep a Flick in one place? Oh—a moth. Five more minutes? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, where accountability has difficulty focusing.

lines.native: Va bene, mi fermo! Riddle me this: where do we—oh, a spark. Dove devo andare? You steer; I’ll supervise. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: All right, I’m stopping! Riddle me this: where do we—oh, a spark. Where should I go? You steer; I’ll supervise. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues on his behalf; apparently, it has not received the memo.

lines.native: “Left” è inglese! In italiano, per favore: dove devo andare? Riddle me—oh, smoke. Your navigation has subtitles missing. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: “Left” is English! In Italian, please: where should I go? Riddle me—oh, smoke. Your navigation has subtitles missing. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains just outside your field of vision, where supervision is cheapest.

lines.native: A sinistra, sì! Sono qui! Ma perché tanta fretta? Possiamo aspettare? Riddle me this: what runs but—oh, a beetle. Just five more minutes. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! I'm here! But why such a hurry? Can we wait? Riddle me this: what runs but—oh, a beetle. Just five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick scuttles left, remaining firmly in the corner of your vision. A tiny firecracker announces a break nobody authorised.

lines.native: Sì! Canti con me! Ma così aspettiamo ancora. Vuoi aspettare? Riddle me—oh, another spark. Your delay game: immaculate. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Yes! You’re singing with me! But this way we’re still waiting. Do you want to wait? Riddle me—oh, another spark. Your delay game: immaculate. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where accountability has difficulty focusing.

lines.native: Adesso? Non domani? Va bene, hai vinto! Andiamo subito! Your timing: rude, effective. Un indovinello: che cosa—oh, camminiamo davvero. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Now? Not tomorrow? All right, you win! Let’s go immediately! Your timing: rude, effective. A riddle: what—oh, we’re really walking. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker goes unthrown; even distractions occasionally suffer administrative defeat.
